audit.whatIsWrong: Zoe's slots were scrambled throughout. The content layer called the bubble her Q and the charged missile her E ('Land Q bubble into charged E'), and called her blink a 'W blink' in four places. It also invented an ability, 'Zzzap', and told the player to 'Hold W to negate her E poke' — Ring of Frost negates nothing.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q is Paddle Star! (800, redirectable, more damage the longer it flies), E is Sleepy Trouble Bubble (800, sleep, 18/17/16/15/14s), W is Spell Thief (stolen summoners), R is Portal Jump (575, blink out and back after 1 second, 11/8/5s). The kill pattern is E bubble into a fully charged Q, not the reverse, and her escape is R, not W. Sleep also reduces the target's Magic Resist and doubles the first damage that breaks it, which is the resistances-invalidated entry in the missing-interactions file.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere, 'Zzzap' removed, W's role restated as a 450 root, and the sleep's MR reduction and damage-doubling folded into whys[3] and dosFull[1].d.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R text, ranges and cooldowns

notes: Heaviest matchup in the slice. Zoe's slots were reversed in the content layer — the bubble is E and the charged missile is Q, not the other way round — and her blink was called a 'W blink' in four places when W is Spell Thief and the blink is Portal Jump (R, 575, 1 second out and back, 11/8/5s). An invented ability, 'Zzzap', was removed from wants.foe[1]. All 15 MISGENDER lint entries are fixed, including the six report entries the lint flagged; those report edits are pronoun-only and are not part of the templating sweep. Chart: full layer disagreed with content on five rows; content already matched the packet, so only the full layer moved, each side edit paired with its why — no win[N] edit was possible. Both missingInteractions entries are stated: the sleep's MR reduction and doubled break-damage (so resistances are the wrong answer), and More Sparkles!'s empowered auto as the wind-up cue. Not asserted (kit silent): whether Frozen Tomb's self-cast counts as the damage that breaks the sleep, whether the sleep is cleansable or tenacity-reduced, and whether Portal Jump can be used while rooted. Question for the user: dontsFull[1].t reads 'Burn the claw to dodge what W answers' — I could not tell which of Zoe's abilities that don't is about, so I left it and its body untouched.
